insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Sum Insured is as per Schedule)

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre -existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.reference: Section C.I.iii) Pre-Existing Diseases (Code – Excl01), Page 13
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the start of coverage. You need to maintain continuous coverage for 3 years before PED claims become payable.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Section C.I.i) 30-day Waiting period (Code – Excl03), Page 11
good.explanation: Illness claims are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents. This is the standard waiting period in the industry.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments as mentioned in the table below shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.reference: Section C.I.ii) Specified disease/procedure waiting period (Code – Excl02), Page 11
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period. This is a common and acceptable waiting time.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Treatment at home is covered under certain conditions. This provides flexibility for non-hospitalized care.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Emergency Ambulance: Expenses incurred on an ambulance in an emergency, subject to Rs. 2000 per Hospitalisation.
good.explanation: Ambulance expenses are covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalization. This helps with emergency transport costs but has a low limit.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: No restore/reinstatement benefit wording found in the provided document.
bad.reference: Not mentioned in provided Policy Wording extract
bad.explanation: Sum Insured is not replenished after a claim. Once you exhaust your limit, no extra cover is provided.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Annexure I – List of Non-Medical Expenses ... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 68 VASOFIX SAFETY
bad.reference: Annexure I – List of Non-Medical Expenses, Page 31-32
bad.explanation: Items like gloves, masks, and syringes are excluded and must be paid out-of-pocket. This increases your personal expenses during hospitalization.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Pre-Hospitalization Medical expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 30 days before Hospitalisation.
bad.explanation: Pre-hospitalization expenses are covered only for 30 days. This is the minimum acceptable duration but less than some better plans.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: Post-Hospitalization Medical expenses for consultations, investigations and medicines incurred upto 60 days after discharge from Hospitalisation.
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for 60 days. This is the minimum standard but shorter than many competitors offering longer cover.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: No Claim Discount - A 5% non-cumulative discount will be offered on the renewal premium payable under the Policy after every CLAIM FREE Policy Year
bad.explanation: No Sum Insured increase on claim-free renewals, only a 5% premium discount. Your coverage does not grow with claim-free years.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Shared Accommodation... 15% ... Single occupancy or any higher accommodation type 30% ... If a claim has been admitted... then, the insured person shall bear 30% ... A Co-payment of 15% shall be applicable to all Day Care Procedures
bad.reference: Section B.III (Special terms and conditions) Co-Payment, Page 9-10
bad.explanation: Co-pay percentages vary by room type and procedure, with 15% to 30% applicable. Actual applicability may depend on plan options or endorsements, so verify your policy details.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote: In-patient Treatment means ... includes Hospital room rent or boarding expenses...
unclear.reference: Important terms You should know, Page 8-9
unclear.explanation: Room rent is covered but the exact room type or any rupee limit is not specified here. Check your policy schedule for details on room category and limits.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
